stories.title: Horns' Simmons flagged for miming urinating on field after sack vs. Vols
stories.summary: Texas defensive end Colin Simmons was given an unsportsmanlike conduct penalty for "simulating using the restroom" after sacking Tennessee QB Faizon Brandon.

stories.title: Pick-12: Texas Tech player returns INTs for TDs on consecutive passes
stories.summary: Texas Tech LB Austin Romaine returned two interceptions for touchdowns on consecutive passes thrown by Sam Houston on Saturday.

stories.title: Ireland players vote to play controversial matches vs. Israel
stories.summary: The Republic of Ireland's controversial Nations League fixtures against Israel will go ahead after players voted for the games to be played.

stories.title: Sources: Packers sign veteran OG Tomlinson off Cowboys' practice squad
stories.summary: The Packers have added some much-needed offensive line help by signing veteran guard Laken Tomlinson off the Cowboys' practice squad, according to the NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

stories.title: Jays' Scherzer delays decision on future until offseason
stories.summary: Blue Jays right-hander Max Scherzer said Saturday he will wait until the offseason to decide whether he wants to play a 20th major league season in 2027.
